abort.single_instance_allowed: ZPMyFitnessCards is already set up. Add people to it with "Add person".

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the host, port, user, password and database name.

data_description.db_url: For example postgresql://user:password@192.168.1.10:5432/zp_my_fitness. The database must already exist.

postgresql.description: Use a database of its own for ZPMyFitnessCards, not the one Home Assistant's recorder uses.
postgresql.title: Postgres database

data_description.engine: SQLite keeps a file in the configuration folder, which Home Assistant backups include. Postgres uses a database you run and back up yourself.

user.description: Choose where ZPMyFitnessCards keeps its data. Afterwards, add each person with "Add person".
user.title: Database

abort.erased: Deleted all of this person's food, weights and goals.
abort.exported: {link}Download {name}'s data{link_end}: their food diary and weights, and the saved foods, as CSV files in a ZIP. The link works for {minutes} minutes.
abort.imported: Imported {weights} weights and {days} days of calories.
abort.no_recorder: The recorder is not running, so there is no history to import.
abort.not_loaded: ZPMyFitnessCards is not loaded. Reload it, then try again.

error.bad_line: Line {line} of {file} could not be read.
error.bad_row: Row {row} on {day} could not be read.
error.birth_date_future: The birth date must be in the past.
error.database_unavailable: Could not read the database to find this person's earlier data. Try again once ZPMyFitnessCards is loaded.
error.date_not_english: The diary's dates are not in English. Switch MyFitnessPal to English, then save the page again.
error.height_out_of_range: Enter a height from 3 ft 4 in to 8 ft 2 in.
error.macros_not_100: Protein, carbs and fat must add up to 100%.
error.mixed_date_orders: Line {line} of {file} has the day and month the other way round from earlier lines. Use the file as MyFitnessPal sent it.
error.name_taken: Another person already has this name.
error.no_calories: The diary has no Calories column.
error.no_statistics: The recorder keeps no long-term statistics for this sensor.
error.not_myfitnesspal: This is not a MyFitnessPal export or a saved printable diary.
error.nothing_selected: Choose a weight sensor, a calories sensor or both.
error.nothing_to_import: The file has no food or weights up to today.
error.save_complete: The page has no diary rows. Open the printable diary, wait for it to load, then save it with Save Page As as a complete web page.
error.start_date_future: The start date cannot be in the future.
error.weight_out_of_range: Line {line} of {file} has a weight outside 20–400 kg in this unit. Check the unit.

data_description.calorie_goal: Leave empty to use the goal worked out from the details above. It follows each new weight.
data_description.carbs_pct: Share of the calorie goal from carbs.
data_description.fat_pct: Share of the calorie goal from fat.
data_description.name: Shown on the cards and in the sensors' names. It must differ from every other person's name.
data_description.person_entity: Optional. Cards with no person set show the person linked to whoever is logged in.
data_description.protein_pct: Share of the calorie goal from protein. Protein, carbs and fat must add up to 100%.
data_description.sex: Used with age, height and weight to estimate the calories burnt a day.

erase.description: Deletes every food entry, weight and goal logged for {name}. This cannot be undone. {name} stays, starting again from nothing.
erase.title: Delete all data

data_description.calories_sensor: A sensor that counts calories eaten and keeps long-term statistics.
data_description.weight_sensor: A sensor that has recorded weight, such as an older weight helper.

import_history.description: Copies {name}'s history from sensors the recorder has kept. Weights: each day's average, only for days with no weight yet. Calories: each day's total becomes one “Imported total” entry under Snacks. Running it again adds only what is missing.
import_history.title: Import history

import_mfp.description: Choose MyFitnessPal's export, its ZIP or one of the CSV files in it. Or open MyFitnessPal's printable diary in a browser, wait for it to load, save it with Save Page As as a complete web page, and choose the .html file. On each day the file covers, {name}'s entries from MyFitnessPal are replaced, and food logged here stays. Weights are added only on days that have none. Home Assistant keeps the diary's rows and nothing else from the file.
import_mfp.title: Import from MyFitnessPal

import_mfp_meals.description: The file has meals besides breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks. Choose where each goes.
import_mfp_meals.title: Meals

import_mfp_unit.description: The file does not say the unit of its weights. Choose the one MyFitnessPal used.
import_mfp_unit.title: Weight unit
